text:
*The city archives occupy the basement of the old courthouse — rows upon rows of shelves sagging under the weight of ledgers, tax records, deeds, and shipping manifests going back a century.*

*It takes hours of searching, but you find what you're looking for. The shipping records for the past year tell a clear story: cargo tonnage through Ashenmoor has doubled, but tax revenue has dropped. Someone is moving vast quantities of goods without paying duties.*

*Cross-referencing the Guild records, you find a pattern. Every undocumented shipment routes through warehouses leased to the same entity: the Ashenmoor Merchants' Guild, under Harren's signature.*

*But here's the real find — buried in a stack of old property deeds, a transfer document. Harren has been quietly buying up properties throughout the city: warehouses, a foundry, even a section of the city wall. No merchant needs to own a section of wall.*

*Unless they plan to open a gate that shouldn't be opened.*

choices.text: Copy the key documents as evidence
Take the property deed — someone needs to see this
